Callout.Name: Return to a Domestic Address
Callout.Message: Neighbours reporting shouting again at an address attended last night.
Callout.Advisory: Same address as last night, no weapons reported.

Script.Line: It is the same as last night. It is the same as every night.
Nobody has been hit. Not tonight, not last night.
If you take him away I have got nowhere to go. Do you understand?

Lines.Approach: Same address as last night, same shouting. Somebody has to go back.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
